title: Semilinear extension of an ordinary homology comparison square
statement: Let f0:S0 to D0 and f:S to D be homomorphisms of commutative rings in one universe, and eS:S0 equiv S, eD:D0 equiv D commuting with f0,f [def-weil-module-base-change]. Let P0,P be modules, K0,K complexes over S0,S, and X0,X complexes over D0,D. Given semilinear complex isomorphisms s:K0 to restriction of K and t:X0 to restriction of X, a semilinear module isomorphism k:P0 to restriction of P, and coefficient chain maps delta0,delta whose underlying additive square with s,t commutes, fix degree i. Let a0:P0 to H^i(K0) and a:P to H^i(K) commute with k and H^i(s), using the inverse exact restriction factor. Let b0:D0 tensor_S0 P0 to H^i(X0) and b:D tensor_S P to H^i(X) have adjoint transposes a0;H^i(delta0);restriction homology factor and a;H^i(delta);restriction homology factor. There exists an additive isomorphism l between the two extended modules such that l;forget(b);inverse eD restriction homology factor equals forget(b0);forget(H^i(t)). There is no derived category and no flatness or invertibility assumption on any comparison.

proof.text: Construct the scalar-extension isomorphism by TensorProduct.congr from the semilinear ring and module equivalences, sending d tensor p to eD(d) tensor k(p). Compatibility of f0,f gives balance, and tensor induction upgrades it to D0-linearity into eD restriction. The tensor inverse identities prove invertibility.

Prove exact restriction/forgetting homology coherence from LeftHomologyData.mapHomologyIso_eq and an identity LeftHomologyMapData on the two mapped presentations. Combine this coherence with ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso_hom_naturality to express homology of any semilinear map in additive coordinates.

Forget the ordinary square and the two adjoint equations, and use the preceding homology formula. Apply additive homology to the chain square. Compose these equations and cancel the exact homology isomorphisms, giving equality on unit tensors. ExtendScalars.hom_ext and the constructed isomorphism generator formula yield the D0-linear square. Forget it and cancel the eD restriction factor to get the statement.

theorem exists_scalarExtension_homology_square
    {S₀ S D₀ D : Type u}
    [CommRing S₀] [CommRing S] [CommRing D₀] [CommRing D]
    (f₀ : S₀ →+* D₀) (f : S →+* D)
    (eS : S₀ ≃+* S) (eD : D₀ ≃+* D)
    (hf : eD.toRingHom.comp f₀ = f.comp eS.toRingHom)
    (P₀ : ModuleCat.{u} S₀) (P : ModuleCat.{u} S)
    (K₀ : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} S₀) ℤ)
    (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} S) ℤ)
    (X₀ : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} D₀) ℤ)
    (X : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} D) ℤ)
    (s : K₀ ≅ ((restrictScalars.{u} eS.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K)
    (t : X₀ ≅ ((restrictScalars.{u} eD.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj X)
    (k : P₀ ≅ (restrictScalars.{u} eS.toRingHom).obj P)
    (δ₀ : K₀ ⟶ ((restrictScalars.{u} f₀).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj X₀)
    (δ : K ⟶ ((restrictScalars.{u} f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj X)
    (hδ :
      ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} S₀) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map δ₀ ≫
        ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} D₀) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).map t.hom =
      ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} S₀) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).map s.hom ≫
        ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} S) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map δ)
    (i : ℤ) (a₀ : P₀ ⟶ K₀.homology i) (a : P ⟶ K.homology i)
    (ha : k.hom ≫ (restrictScalars.{u} eS.toRingHom).map a ≫
        ((K.sc i).mapHomologyIso (restrictScalars.{u} eS.toRingHom)).inv =
      a₀ ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap s.hom i)
    (b₀ : (extendScalars f₀).obj P₀ ⟶ X₀.homology i)
    (b : (extendScalars f).obj P ⟶ X.homology i)
    (hb₀ : (extendRestrictScalarsAdj f₀).unit.app P₀ ≫
        (restrictScalars.{u} f₀).map b₀ =
      a₀ ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap δ₀ i ≫
        ((X₀.sc i).mapHomologyIso (restrictScalars.{u} f₀)).hom)
    (hb : (extendRestrictScalarsAdj f).unit.app P ≫
        (restrictScalars.{u} f).map b =
      a ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap δ i ≫
        ((X.sc i).mapHomologyIso (restrictScalars.{u} f)).hom) :
    let F₀ := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} D₀) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} D) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    ∃ l : F₀.obj ((extendScalars f₀).obj P₀) ≅ F.obj ((extendScalars f).obj P),
      l.hom ≫ F.map b ≫ F₀.map ((X.sc i).mapHomologyIso
          (restrictScalars.{u} eD.toRingHom)).inv =
        F₀.map b₀ ≫ F₀.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap t.hom i)
